title: Murry M NDE 2161
content: I was floating up with hand out towards this very bright light. The light was extremely bright, but I could stare and look directly at it. There was a cool breeze blowing across my face it was the most comforting feeling I had or have ever felt. I could see a great figure and was slowly floating up wards towards it, or him, and then I was back as quickly as I was taken. The thought has been buried in my mind to contact this group, which in their mind and heart know what we have to do to try to help man to truly reach GOD because we know without any doubt there is life after death. I look forward to that time again. But at this time, my God has for me; I must find my other brothers and sisters with the same purpose and goal that GOD has burned in my soul heart, and mind. There is only one GOD and one truth and his sheep have heard and hear his voice. I know I have been chosen and what I have to do on this earth the sooner I do this the sooner I will be united with my GOD. This is for those who have always known they were special and just didn't know why. You must meet with your kind and go on with your father's business. Background Information: Gender: Male Date NDE Occurred: Aug. 1987 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Yes Suicide attempt Clinical death (cessation of breathing or heart function or brain function) I was depressed and simply tried to end my life by hanging myself. How do you consider the content of your experience? Wonderful Did you feel separated from your body? Yes I clearly left my body and existed outside it How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? Normal consciousness and alertness At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? From the very beginning. Were your thoughts speeded up? Neither Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Neither I felt as if there was no time. Were your senses more vivid than usual? More so than usual Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. Very bright and crystal clear and peaceful. Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere? Neither Did you pass into or through a tunnel? No Did you see any beings in your experience? Neither Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? No Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin Did you see an unearthly light? Yes Very bright and crystal clear. Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? Clearly mystical or unearthly realm What emotions did you feel during the experience? Peace. Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Incredible peace or pleasantness Did you have a feeling of joy? Incredible joy Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? United, one with the world Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? Everything about the universe Did scenes from your past come back to you? Neither Did scenes from the future come to you? Neither Did you come to a border or point of no return? Neither God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Conservative/fundamentalist Have your religious practices changed since your experience? No What is your religion now? Conservative/fundamentalist Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? No Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? Neither Did you see deceased or religious spirits? Neither Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? Yes I am to help man to reach God through the only true source and that is peace and harmony with one's fellow man. Nature and self. Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? No After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? No Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? No Are there one or several parts of your experience that are especially meaningful or significant to you? The peace that comes with passing from this world to the next, there is no death only life and more peaceful. Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes Very few. Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? No What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real It was very real. What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real Same real. At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No Are there any other questions that we could ask to help you communicate your experience? Quit asking the same questions.

arrival.other_being_detail: He reported seeing "a great figure" and floating upwards toward it/him.

environment.environment_other_detail: Reported a "cool breeze blowing across my face" and a "very bright light" that was "crystal clear".

boundary_and_return.mission_detail: He reported his purpose was "to help man to reach God" through "peace and harmony with one's fellow man. Nature and self."

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Cool breeze/comforting sensation; sense of universal understanding; stated mission to help others reach God through peace/harmony.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Reported leaving the body and floating upward toward a very bright light and a "great figure," then returning quickly; no tunnel, no life review, no boundary reported.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: He described a "cool breeze blowing across my face" as part of the experience.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "There was a cool breeze blowing across my face it was the most comforting feeling I had or have ever felt."; "The peace that comes with passing from this world to the next, there is no death only life and more peaceful."
